name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Fixes automatic section editors stuck loading, preserves drafts without requiring Collection Manager for ordinary sources, moves message controls into a Marquee Message tab with a true looping marquee, removes the Main Top Row Fallback badge, restores subtle detail-page clearance, corrects Author presentation, and prevents the original spotlight from flashing before the configured Media Bar.
